limitations: January-June 2026 outcomes were previously inspected as final tests. They are now development/calibration evidence, not fresh evaluation.

Site-specific support remains unchanged. Original forecast publication times remain unverified; nominal fixed-lead latency margin retained. Neighboring plants/overlapping windows are dependent observations.

plan.acceptance: Positive combined calibration slope; AP strictly exceeds prior and seasonal and Brier strictly improves on both baselines on each new final partition
plan.baseline_prior: Positive frequency in final refit calibration rows
plan.baseline_seasonal: Month sine/cosine logistic regression C1 fitted on 2024-2025 development counties, calibrated on final refit calibration rows
plan.development_disclosure: January-June 2026 outcomes were previously inspected as final tests. They are now development/calibration evidence, not fresh evaluation.
plan.embargo: Purge shared warning-event IDs from earlier calibration/selection phases. July 1-7 excluded to separate this test from previously collected first-July warning intervals.
plan.policy: Keep serving forest and features frozen. Select a recalibration on development outcomes, freeze selection before reading reserved test labels, and evaluate once. Never overwrite the serving artifact.
plan.refit: Selected recalibration only, 2026-01-08 through 2026-06-23 development counties; forest remains unchanged
plan.release: Record passing or failing result honestly in a separate candidate directory; production_approved stays false. Alan reviews deployment, with current artifact retained for rollback. No shared target/contract changes.
plan.selection: 2026-04-01 through 2026-06-23, separate original development and geographic-validation county partitions; minimize their mean Brier error, ties resolved by listed candidate order
plan.target: Unchanged selected NWS warning or heat-advisory exposure during next 24 hours; not injury probability
plan.unused_final_test: 2026-07-08 through 2026-09-30; temporal=original development counties, geographic=original geographic-test counties; 00/06/12/18 UTC cutoffs
plan.validation_scope: Site-specific support remains unchanged. Original forecast publication times remain unverified; nominal fixed-lead latency margin retained. Neighboring plants/overlapping windows are dependent observations.
